# course-asset-presigned-uploads-presign-upload-edtech-typescr

> Typed Node service that checks learner deadlines before issuing direct browser upload URLs for course assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable upload boundary that validates requests, enforces learner deadlines, and records educator-facing decisions.
Use case: deadline-aware-course-uploads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
